_comment: AC-REL-04: pinned SBOM tooling for the published image + host binaries. Config only — CI wires it in .github/workflows/legal.yml (job sbom, non-blocking: it uploads an artifact, it does not (yet) gate the release, since no SBOM-diff policy has been reviewed by a human — see docs/legal/FINDINGS.md).
actionRefVerifiedVia: github.com/anchore/sbom-action/commit/v0 (the `v0` moving tag's current commit, resolved 2026 via web lookup — not a live registry pull from inside this environment). Re-verify before your first real run; a moving major-version tag like `v0` can point to a newer commit by the time you build.
licensePolicyReuse: scripts/legal/notices-policy.json — the SAME fail-closed allowedClasses/weakCopyleftAllowlist gate applies to whatever syft reports; no separate, drifting policy.

provenance.invariant: a published version's image digest is immutable once recorded — verify-provenance.sh fails closed on any attempt to re-record a DIFFERENT digest for the same version, run AFTER .github/workflows/publish.yml's `merge` job assembles the multi-arch manifest and captures its digest via `docker buildx imagetools inspect`.
